title: Bell Pepper
description: Bell peppers are the mild, sweet-fruited form of Capsicum annuum. They are botanically fruits, and can turn from green to red, yellow, or other colors as they ripen.

title: Cayenne
description: Cayenne peppers are usually long, slender, hot varieties of Capsicum annuum. Their heat commonly falls around 30,000–50,000 Scoville Heat Units, though it varies by variety and growing conditions.

title: Carolina Reaper
description: The Carolina Reaper is a Capsicum chinense hybrid bred by Ed Currie. Guinness World Records recognized it in 2013 as the world's hottest chili pepper, with an average heat of 1,641,183 Scoville Heat Units.
